description: Automated tests for duplicate-delivery, burst coalescing, and cross-tenant signed-URL minting

title: Managed document intelligence integration

title: Provider proxy + circuit breaker
description: Primary/secondary LLM providers, trip on 3x 429/5xx or >5s, degradation ladder to semantic cache then escalation script

title: ai_config table + eval-gated thresholds
description: All thresholds (similarity, top_k, timeout, debounce, history) in versioned config rows; publish blocked on eval regression

acceptance_criteria: Hit rate measured on real traffic; cached replies served in <600ms p95

acceptance_criteria: Renamed provider field fails CI before it fails a guest

title: Streaming responses
description: Stream first token to widget; typing indicator; hard timeout to escalation script
acceptance_criteria: Perceived first response <=2.4s p95 on mobile

acceptance_criteria: Offering sold to at least one design partner; hours tracked against fee
